entities.summary: Gerardo Pierro was an Italian ordinary of the Catholic Church. He served as the Bishop of Tursi-Lagonegro, as the Bishop of Avellino, and as the Archbishop of Salerno-Campagna-Acerno. In this last role, he simultaneously held the title of Primate of the Kingdom of Naples..
